name: OpenAI

source.quote: the company's annualized revenue has surpassed $20 billion in 2025, up from $6 billion in 2024 with growth closely tracking an expansion in computing capacity.
OpenAI has closed its latest financing round with $122bn in committed capital, giving the AI company a post-money valuation of $852bn.

description: Maker of ChatGPT and the GPT models; restructured in 2025 into OpenAI Group PBC controlled by the OpenAI Foundation.
explain: OpenAI is the biggest buyer in the AI money web: it has promised hundreds of billions of dollars to cloud and chip companies, and raises record sums from Microsoft, Amazon, Nvidia and SoftBank to pay for it.
